title: PAPA: Portable Aeronautics Physics Assembler
description: Assemble and disassemble Create Aeronautics physics structures with a handheld tool instead of placing/breaking Physics Assemblers all the time.
body:
This mod adds a handheld/tool version of [Create Aeronautics](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-aeronautics)' **[Physics Assembler](https://create-aeronautics.fandom.com/wiki/Physics_Assembler)**. You can assemble and disassemble your honey-glued contraptions directly from your hotbar.

## How it works

It's just one item, and it does exactly what you'd expect:

*   **Right-click a block:** Assembles that block (and whatever is glued to it) into a physics object.
*   **Shift + Right-click a physics object:** Disassembles it back into normal blocks, instantly snapping it to the nearest grid position and 90° rotation.

Under the hood, it uses the exact same server-side logic as the standard Aeronautics block, so the results are identical.

## Crafting

Combine a normal **Physics Assembler** with two **Sticks** on a diagonal:

![Crafting Recipe](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1744/844/crafting_recipe-png.png)

If you're in Creative, you'll find it in the Tools & Utilities tab.

> **Dev note:** Unlike the physical block, this handheld tool snaps your physics contraption to the grid instantly when you disassemble. Since a held item doesn't have a tick loop, it skips the slow, multi-tick alignment animation the block usually does.

## Requirements

This is an add-on, so you absolutely need [Create Aeronautics](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-aeronautics) installed to use it.

## Modpacks

Feel free to use my mods in your modpack, just don't forget to give proper credit.
